name: WARNING: Al Dente Undercooked Pasta (Resistant Starch & Hard Core)
whyItWorks: Chewy al dente pasta has an ungelatinized, dense starch core. In healthy people this acts as beneficial resistant starch; in IBD patients with impaired digestion, ungelatinized starch escapes small bowel absorption and triggers rapid bacterial fermentation and bloating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always cook pasta 1–2 minutes past the standard al dente package directions until tender throughout. When ordering at Italian restaurants, request pasta 'ben cotta' (well cooked).
